view.summary: A branching text adventure: as Snow White, pick an area to search, make choices page by page and collect all 21 endings. Items found on one run open new choices on later runs.

overview.title: How it plays
items: Choose one of the areas, then read and pick choices until you reach an ending. Some pages give an item; some choices need an item or an ending you have already seen.
1 attempt per day (max 1): reaching an ending you haven't recorded yet uses it
1 reward attempt per day (max 1); reaching any ending with an attempt left gives:
Skip the search and go straight to NORMAL ENDING 1 (“End of Expedition”) to collect the day’s reward. Opens after 1 new ending(s).
From 2023-05-16 20:00: endings no longer use attempts (rewards still once a day)
In the archive rerun every area after the first opens by reaching an ending instead of on a date (see the areas table).

pages.title: White Memory
pages.text: Complete the search log as Snow White.

pages.title: Start Game
pages.text:
You can start a new search if a new ending is available.
You can continue the game if one is in progress.

pages.title: Select Area
pages.text:
Select the area to search.
You will encounter different events in different areas.
Specific areas will be activated at different times and according to certain conditions pertaining to the ending.

pages.title: Options
pages.text:
Story Branching Point.
These choices affect the direction of the story.
They also determine the ending.

pages.title: Return
pages.text: Tap Return on the display page in Recollections to go back to the last page.

pages.title: Ending
pages.text:
Certain selections will lead you to different endings.
Whenever you achieve a new ending, the chance to gain new endings will decrease by one.
Available attempts to gain new endings reset at 05:00 (UTC+9) daily.
All collected endings will be recorded on the Recollections page.

pages.title: Obtain Rewards
pages.text:
You can obtain rewards if reward attempts remain when an ending has been achieved.
Reward attempts will be deducted upon obtaining rewards.
Achieving endings also grants you rewards.
Available attempts to obtain rewards reset at 05:00 (UTC+9) daily.

pages.title: Stand Guard
pages.text: You can select Stand Guard to achieve an ending quickly.

pages.title: Item
pages.text:
Items that were obtained during a search.
They are used to unlock certain story choices.
Once obtained, items can be used as many times as you wish.

pages.title: Recollections
pages.text:
Records all collected endings.
You can replay different endings on this page.

pages.title: Endless Mode
pages.text:
Endless Mode will be opened at 05:00 (UTC +9) on the last event day.
Endless Mode does not consume attempts to collect endings.
You can obtain rewards only once a day in the Endless Mode.
